title: Large Attachment Bloat Watch
dataSources: Breach alerts (`breach:alert`), inbox stats (`inbox:stats`), cloud-drive usage (`clouddrive:usage`), certificate expiry (`certexpiry:check`).
app: Personal cybersecurity feeds — Have-I-Been-Pwned breach alerts, personal email/inbox stats, cloud-storage usage APIs, and personal TLS-certificate expiry checks — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=inbox:stats
| stats avg(large_attachment_mb) as avg_attachment_mb, sum(large_attachment_count) as large_attachments by account
| sort - avg_attachment_mb
description: Shows which accounts are accumulating the heaviest attachment burden.
value: Large attachments are an easy source of inbox drag and often explain why storage usage grows faster than expected.
implementation: Send attachment-size statistics with inbox snapshots; compare average large-attachment size and count by account.
visualization: Account table of average large attachment size and total count.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces which email accounts are filling up with bulky attachments and quietly driving storage growth.
